sources.title: UniFi Access Point | Releases | Ubiquiti Community

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Improvements

Improved network self-healing: APs now consistently revert to stable wired connections, automatically clearing unintended wireless paths after topology changes.

Additional information
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
articles.title: UniFi Access Point for U7-LR 8.0.64

articles.title: UniFi Access Point for U6-LR, U6-Lite, U6+ & more 6.7.41

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release applies for these models:

UAP-AC-Lite/LR/Pro/M/M-PRO/IW/UK-Ultra
UAP-HD/SHD/XG/BaseStationXG
U6-Pro/Mesh/IW/Extender/Enterprise/Enterprise-IW

Improvements

Improved network self-healing: APs now consistently revert to stable wired connections, automatically clearing unintended wireless paths after topology changes.

Additional information
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
